verbatim_user_feedback: 这个不就是最普通的字体吗？
context: User directly viewed the A neutral Songti and B purported designed lettering and challenged their appearance as ordinary typefaces.

interpretation_boundary.A: Deliberate neutral Songti reading baseline. Being ordinary is expected, so do not count this as a separate failure of baseline purpose.
interpretation_boundary.B: Fails to demonstrate an independently recognizable professional original brand-lettering identity. Treat as human feedback indicating insufficient aesthetic improvement, not as proof that exact standard font glyphs were copied.
interpretation_boundary.provenance: User visual reaction in current continued ChatGPT design-research conversation. No independent blind vote or numerical preference was provided.
interpretation_boundary.broad_font_identity: Unknown: available assets are raster PNGs, not font-source provenance or editable native outline files.

root_cause.demonstrated: More silhouette change and lower IoU did not produce an obvious brand-specific identity. Technical validity passed, creative design quality not demonstrated.
root_cause.likely_mechanism: Prompt requests restraint and subtle tail changes but does not impose or verify a meaningful whole-word concept, coherent original structural decision, or professional art direction before generation.
root_cause.not_proven: Which actual font file (if any) the image generator used, artistic intent inside the black-box generator, general impossibility of producing designer-level wordmarks.

new_stop_and_start_rules: Stop benchmarking these two existing wordmarks for a winner; keep A as recognition baseline and B as a negative creative example.
Do not ask the user or outside readers to select between obviously inadequate creative candidates; blind intake artifacts may remain archived but are no longer the next required action.
Do not use numeric contour difference, font-distance, glyph-path count, or prompt length as proof of original design quality.

Before any new art generation, require one concrete brand concept with a visible design mechanism at whole-word and character levels, explicit intentional edits, coherent relationships, and stop/reversion criteria. Test design distinctness against a standard font before spending Figma effort.

Any later proposed creative variant must first clear basic glyph correctness and demonstrably not look like a stock font with incidental brush/tail deformation; then direct user creative review, followed by genuinely independent study only when scientifically warranted.
No retries of R1-R29, 喜, 金尊, 舟影茶馆 using minimal stroke width/spacing variations.
